name: @ai-crew-suite/otel-container
description: Standalone otel-collector daemon container with custom gRPC pipeline data routing maps

scripts.build: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image build otel-container
scripts.lint: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image lint otel-container
scripts.image:test:security: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image test security otel-container
scripts.image:test:structure: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image test structure otel-container
scripts.publish: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image publish otel-container
scripts.test: yarn image:test:security && yarn image:test:structure && yarn test:unit
